labelProvenance.annotator: Data/Evaluation Builder, assistant visual review of raw native PNGs and manually positioned zoom crops
labelProvenance.pixelDefinition: Manual centre of the visible ball image, or approximate midpoint of its visible motion streak. Not the instantaneous physical ball centre or ground-contact point.
labelProvenance.method: Raw source frames and coordinate-grid crops only. No HSV detector, model predictions, landing CSV, automatic centroid or trajectory interpolation used for labels. Five pre-seal coordinate refinements use grayscale-contrast weighted moments ONLY inside visually hand-selected ball ROIs, not automatic component detection.

contractorCrosscheck.reviewerAndScope: Root Contractor assistant: all35 point-centred raw RGB crops;3 native fullframes including tennist01f29 and tennist03f36; five pre-seal coordinate refinements raw-grid image. Accepted R2 before inference; not human review.
